latest.headline: MU set to gap down about 6% after Monday's 19% surge
latest.tldr: MU closed Monday at $707.70 (+19.04%) on the Nvidia relief rally, last printed $664.48 (−6.11%) at 6:54 ET, and I expect an open about 4% to 9% lower (roughly $644–$679), centred near −6.3%, with $650.00 as the first support underneath.
